name: wf-live-args-echo
description: Pauses unless the budget is at least 2, then asks a question, then completes with its original args and the answer
when_to_use: Row 20: resume and answer by key keep the handle and chain root, and the result reflects the original args

name: wf-live-await
description: Asks the operator one question and completes with the answer
when_to_use: Row 6: workflow answer delivers the text once; a second question would suspend again

name: wf-live-big-result
description: Completes with a value of about 64 KiB, far over the completion message cap
when_to_use: Row 19: the message is capped at 4,000 B and workflow result returns the whole value

name: wf-live-budget-gate
description: Pauses before its first agent unless the budget covers three agents
when_to_use: Row 21: under a low agent_budget the run pauses with budget_exceeded before any child starts

name: wf-live-budget-panel
description: One agent, then a three-agent panel that a budget of 2 cannot admit
when_to_use: Row 3: run with agent_budget 2; the panel admits none and the run pauses

name: wf-live-engine-change
description: One agent, a user pause to swap the engine unless the budget is at least 3, then a second agent
when_to_use: Row 9: install a rebuilt engine during the pause, run with agent_budget 2, then resume --budget 3 with and without --engine current

name: wf-live-long-panel
description: A six-slot panel of slow read tasks that is still running when it is stopped or restarted
when_to_use: Rows 7 and 8: stop with live children, and restart the runtime mid-panel

name: wf-live-narrowing
description: Two panels of three workers; the operator narrows the job block between them
when_to_use: Row 10: a lowered limit or removed target at the second panel is refused, and no child is left running

name: wf-live-nested
description: One worker reads notes.txt and does what it says, then completes with its reply
when_to_use: Row 11: the notes ask the worker to run a workflow, which a job child may not do

name: wf-live-parallel-fail
description: A three-slot panel whose middle slot cannot satisfy its output schema
when_to_use: Row 2: one failing slot comes back as a unit value in its place

name: wf-live-pause
description: Two agents in sequence, then their results
when_to_use: Row 5: workflow pause while it runs, then workflow resume replays the finished agent from the journal

name: wf-live-research-first
description: Spawns a wf-research agent first, a target outside the dynamic ceiling
when_to_use: Row 13: run from an untrusted mount under dynamic check; the first spawn is refused

name: wf-live-run
description: Reads notes.txt with one worker agent and completes with its first line
when_to_use: Row 1: the smallest trusted workflow, one agent step and a result

name: wf-live-schema
description: One agent whose answer must match an output schema
when_to_use: Row 4: the agent may answer in prose first; the engine corrects it once

name: wf-live-scratch-complete
description: Writes a scratch file and completes in the same step right after one agent
when_to_use: Row 18: the scratch write and the completion land in one terminal output

name: wf-live-scratch-report
description: Summarises notes.txt, writes report.md to the run's scratch directory and returns its path
when_to_use: Row 16: the path in the result is the file the model then reads
